## What's changed

- Updated automatic audio selection to favor the highest-quality English, non-commentary track, including TrueHD and DTS-HD sources, even when player compatibility requires audio transcoding.
- Kept direct-play compatibility as a final tie-breaker instead of allowing a lower-quality AC-3 or AAC track to override a better source track.
- Fixed the Tube TV custom-channel editor so the bumper dropdown and remove button stay inside the page at narrower desktop widths.
